definitionZh: :hover CSS 假类在用户使用指针设备与其交互时,匹配一个元素. 当用户将光标(mouse pointer)移动到一个元素上而不按鼠标按钮时,通常会触发伪类.
sourceDefinition: The :hover CSS pseudo-class matches an element when a user interacts with it using a pointing device. The pseudo-class is generally triggered when the user moves the cursor (mouse pointer) over an element without pressing the mouse button.
